assertions: A fresh forgot-password request for the disposable Assessor account returned the generic Check your email success screen and delivered a new recovery email.
The new recovery link was opened in a separate signed-out Chrome profile and displayed the Recover Account confirmation page.
Submitting the confirmation could not reach the new-password form because the deployed invisible reCAPTCHA rendered ERROR for site owner: Invalid domain for site key.
The existing-password reuse behavior therefore remains unverified; no password change was submitted and the account password remains unchanged.
